# CodePackr Study — Repository Instructions

- CodePackr Study is a privacy-first student and exam-tools application.
- Academic inputs, notes, flashcards, grades, citation data, and practice data remain client-side.
- Preserve the indigo visual identity, responsive design, and accessibility patterns.
- Every student tool should be complete and usable without an account.
- Reuse existing components, data structures, routing, and utilities.
- Never invent academic standards, citation rules, or exam claims.
- New tools should include sample/demo, reset/clear, copy/export where useful, and useful error states.
- Keep routes, SEO metadata, README, and docs synchronized.
- Source changes require lint and production build.
- Documentation-only, README-only, and .github-only changes do not require a production build; CI and Vercel are configured to ignore those changes.
